raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "physical size of the cantilever domain",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 7 determines the aspect ratio through 16 x 2 x 2 equal coarse cubes, but never gives their physical edge length.",
      "readings": [
        "Coarse cube edge a=1: domain dimensions (16,2,2).",
        "Coarse cube edge a=0.5: domain dimensions (8,1,1).",
        "Normalize the cantilever length to 1: domain dimensions (1,0.125,0.125)."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "z-directed load centered on the right-hand face",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 7 says the load is applied 'in the middle' of the right-hand face and refers to Fig. 2(a). The prose does not specify its footprint or distribution among nodes.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force on the central node at (Lx,Ly/2,Lz/2).",
        "A uniform line load across 0<=y<=Ly at x=Lx, z=Lz/2.",
        "A uniform traction on the centered patch x=Lx, 3Ly/8<=y<=5Ly/8, 3Lz/8<=z<=5Lz/8."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "signed sense of the right-face load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 7 specifies direction z without explicitly stating its signed sense. Reversing this sole load leaves the linear-elastic compliance and optimal density unchanged.",
      "readings": [
        "Load acts in +z.",
        "Load acts in -z."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "resultant right-face force",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Neither Sec. 7, the CANT example, nor Table 1 specifies the force magnitude or its units.",
      "readings": [
        "Total resultant force magnitude F=1 in consistent units.",
        "Total resultant force magnitude F=2 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "allowed material volume V",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) defines sum(rho_i)=V, but no numerical V or volume fraction is supplied for CANT-16-2-2-5. The later 0.8V concerns visualization.",
      "readings": [
        "With unit upper density, V=0.1m: volume fraction 0.1.",
        "With unit upper density, V=0.2m: volume fraction 0.2.",
        "With unit upper density, V=0.5m: volume fraction 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "upper density bounds",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (1) supplies upper bounds only symbolically. Sec. 7.1 specifies numerical lower bounds but never assigns numerical upper bounds.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform upper bound rho_max=1.",
        "Uniform upper bound rho_max=2."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "uniform elastic stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The stiffness matrices in Eq. (1) are not accompanied by a numerical reference modulus, such as Young's modulus.",
      "readings": [
        "Reference Young's modulus E=1 in consistent units.",
        "Reference Young's modulus E=2 in the same units, with all other stiffness ratios unchanged."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "elastic constitutive tensor apart from its overall scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text gives neither Poisson's ratio nor an explicit isotropy assumption or constitutive tensor.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous isotropic elasticity with Poisson's ratio 0.25.",
        "Homogeneous isotropic elasticity with Poisson's ratio 0.30.",
        "Homogeneous orthotropic elasticity aligned with x,y,z: Ex=2Ey=2Ez, nu_xy=nu_xz=nu_yz=0.25, Gxy=Gxz=Gyz=0.4Ey, with reciprocal Poisson ratios."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "element stiffness integration",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.2 specifies trilinear hexahedral displacement elements and elementwise constant densities, but does not specify the integration rule used to construct their stiffness matrices.",
      "readings": [
        "Full 2 x 2 x 2 Gauss integration.",
        "Selective reduced integration: full integration of deviatoric terms and one-point integration of volumetric terms."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial PBM penalty parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.2 gives initial primal variables, multipliers, penalty floors, and update factors, but no initial values for p, q_lower, or q_upper.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize every p_i, q_lower_i, and q_upper_i to 1.",
        "Initialize every p_i, q_lower_i, and q_upper_i to 0.1.",
        "Initialize p_i=1 and q_lower_i=q_upper_i=0.01."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PBM Newton backtracking line search",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Algorithm 2 names backtracking with the Armijo rule but supplies no sufficient-decrease constant, contraction factor, or initial trial step.",
      "readings": [
        "Initial step 1, Armijo constant 0.0001, contraction factor 0.5.",
        "Initial step 1, Armijo constant 0.01, contraction factor 0.8."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "multigrid smoothing schedule",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6.1 specifies a Gauss-Seidel smoother and one V-cycle per preconditioner application, but not the numbers or directions of smoothing sweeps.",
      "readings": [
        "One forward presweep and one backward postsweep.",
        "Two forward presweeps and two backward postsweeps."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "ordering used by Gauss-Seidel",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 6.2 mentions a 'reasonably good numbering' without fixing node or displacement-component ordering, which affects Gauss-Seidel and iteration counts.",
      "readings": [
        "Lexicographic nodes with x varying fastest and displacement components interleaved.",
        "Lexicographic nodes with z varying fastest and displacement components interleaved.",
        "Lexicographic nodes with displacement components stored in separate blocks."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "coarsest-grid linear solve",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6 defines the Galerkin coarse operators but does not state how accurately or by which method the coarsest system is solved.",
      "readings": [
        "Direct Cholesky solve to working precision.",
        "Iterative coarse solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-10."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial guesses for MINRES solves",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 6 specifies MINRES tolerances but does not specify the starting vector for each linear solve. The outer-variable initializations do not uniquely determine these vectors.",
      "readings": [
        "Start every MINRES solve from zero.",
        "Warm-start equilibrium solves with the previous displacement and Newton solves with the previous increment."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial DOC density",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Secs. 3.2 and 4.1 explicitly initialize PBM and IP densities, but Sec. 5 and Algorithm 4 do not initialize DOC.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density rho_i=V/m.",
        "A feasible nonuniform initial density: equal x-halves at the mean plus and minus half the distance from the mean to the nearest density bound."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "initial delayed IP barrier values",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 initializes r=s=0.01, but Algorithm 3 first assigns r=r_plus and s=s_plus before showing any initialization of r_plus and s_plus.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize r_plus=s_plus=0.01, preserving the initial barrier values through the first delayed update.",
        "Initialize r_plus and s_plus from the initial complementarity averages using the stated factor 0.2."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PBM lower-bound multiplier update",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Algorithm 1, line 7 uses phi_prime(+nu_lower/q_lower), whereas Eq. (11) applied to the constraint in Eq. (16) requires phi_prime(-nu_lower/q_lower).",
      "readings": [
        "Update mu_lower with the negative argument required by Eqs. (11) and (16).",
        "Update mu_lower with the positive argument printed in Algorithm 1."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "PBM lower-nu residual in the reduced Newton solve",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Eq. (17) contains -mu_lower_prime in the lower-nu residual, but the corresponding expressions in Eqs. (20) and (21) contain +mu_lower_prime.",
      "readings": [
        "Construct the reduced right-hand side and reconstruction from Eq. (17), using -mu_lower_prime.",
        "Use +mu_lower_prime as printed in Eqs. (20) and (21)."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "IP stationarity and complementarity residuals",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "The displayed residual in Sec. 4.1 adds upper nu positively to stationarity and places its complementarity term in residual block 4. The preceding KKT equations and Eq. (23) instead require a negative stationarity term and upper complementarity in block 5.",
      "readings": [
        "Follow the KKT equations and Eq. (23): negative upper-nu stationarity contribution, with separate lower and upper complementarity blocks.",
        "Follow the displayed residual literally: positive upper-nu stationarity contribution, both complementarity contributions in block 4, and block 5 equal to -s."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "IP volume-multiplier sign used in the duality gap",
      "issue": "conflicting",
      "description": "Sec. 4 says alpha has the same meaning as in the dual problem, but its KKT stationarity uses +alpha where Eq. (2) implies -alpha. Algorithm 3 then evaluates the gap using Eq. (7).",
      "readings": [
        "Treat alpha_IP as -alpha_dual and convert its sign when evaluating Eq. (7).",
        "Retain the dual meaning of alpha and change the IP stationarity and corresponding Newton equations to use -alpha."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
